title: Order topology (DAG lineage)
description: Records the DAG lineage of an order within a process. The on-chain kernel stores only per-process accumulator state; parent-order edges are carried here and committed via agreementHash.

fields.name: topologyMode
fields.description: How the parent lineage is determined.

fields.name: parentOrderHashes
fields.description: Parent order hashes (bytes32 hex). Empty for root orders.
